public_rationale: On 20 January 2025, the day of the post, Altman wrote on X that 'twitter hype is out of control again', that OpenAI was 'not gonna deploy AGI next month, nor have we built it', and that people should 'chill and cut your expectations 100x'. Two news outlets reported this the same day, and Decrypt called it a 'sharp U-turn' from his 5 January blog post. Read plainly, 'walked it back' means he played down the idea that AGI was close, and that is what he did. He did not formally retract his 5 January line that OpenAI knows how to build AGI, so the claim is supported on the ordinary reading, not as a literal retraction.
limitations: Relies on news reports quoting the X post, not the post itself.
Whether a denial of near-term deployment counts as 'walking back' a claim of knowing how to build AGI is a matter of reading.

criteria.contradiction_condition: No such statement by Altman on or about 2025-01-20, or a statement that day that repeated or strengthened the claim that AGI was close.
